lines: Here's how to remake a design in ReStyles. It takes about a minute.
Drop in the design. A photo, a screenshot, a PDF. Anything.
Tell it what to change, in plain words. A new name, a new date, a new headline.
Hit Remake it. About a minute later your new version is back, and nothing else has moved.
Download it, open it in the editor to fix a detail, or make every size. It's already saved to your library.
That's it. One design in. A finished piece out.
music: Bright, friendly, upbeat pop bed with claps and plucks, 120 bpm, light and clean, no vocals
